dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: I'd like to make a reservation for tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.answer: Certainly! For how many people and what time?
dialogue.answer_uz: Albatta! Necha kishi uchun va soat nechada?
options: Certainly! For how many people and what time?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.answer: Yes, I'll have the grilled chicken, please.
options: Yes, I'll have the grilled chicken, please.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.answer: Our chef's special today is the seafood pasta. It's delicious!
dialogue.answer_uz: Bugungi oshpaz maxsusi - dengiz mahsulotlari makaron. Juda mazali!
options: Our chef's special today is the seafood pasta. It's delicious!

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Could we have the bill, please?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.answer: Of course! I'll bring it right away.
options: Of course! I'll bring it right away.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Can I get you something to drink?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.answer: Yes, I'd like a glass of orange juice, please.
dialogue.answer_uz: Ha, bir stakan apelsin sharbati ovolaman, iltimos.
options: Yes, I'd like a glass of orange juice, please.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Does this dish contain nuts? I'm allergic.
dialogue.text_uz: Bu taomda yong'oq bormi? Menda allergiya bor.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.answer: Let me check with the kitchen. I'll be right back.
options: Let me check with the kitchen. I'll be right back.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Excuse me, this steak is undercooked.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.answer: I'm so sorry about that. Let me take it back and cook it more.
dialogue.answer_uz: Buning uchun uzr so'rayman. Olib ketib yana pishirtiraman.
options: I'm so sorry about that. Let me take it back and cook it more.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Would you like to see the dessert menu?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.answer: Yes, please! What's your most popular dessert?
dialogue.answer_uz: Ha, iltimos! Eng mashhur desertingiz nima?
options: Yes, please! What's your most popular dessert?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Can I get this to go, please?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.answer: Absolutely! I'll pack it up for you.
options: Absolutely! I'll pack it up for you.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Can we split the bill, please?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.answer: Of course! How would you like to divide it?
options: Of course! How would you like to divide it?
